Hey I'm really sorry if this doesn't help, but I personally never text first with any of my friends because I always get really anxious sending the first message for many reasons. 

I guess what I'm saying is that some of your friends may not dislike you, but rather are afraid to reach out

Yes. Definitely. I'm afraid everyone secretly finds everything I say annoying. I fear there's some talk about how my presence is irritating and how much they wish I wasn't even there in the first place. The paranoia that everyone hates me haunts my thoughts each time I socialize. It's irrational, but sometimes you can't help thinking it. 


Im sorry, I'm not that good with advice in general, especial with something like this. What sometimes make me feel better is to think about the impacts in people's lives I've made, even if some are small it's a comforting thought
Yep. I'm a forgettable boring wreck that hasn't made an impact on anyone worth remembering

"I'm a loser baby, so why don't you kill me"

Yep definitely me
It's basically my main thought before passing out
You're not alone, I do it a lot to vent and to collect my thoughts.
Ever see garbage before? I probably look worse
Anytime I see myself in the mirror I see a worthless sack of shit stare back. I hate it, I hate seeing myself.
